label: 能量/应激状态 → 内分泌共同语言 → 胰岛状态切换 → 糖尿病

precedence.within_scope: This batch is the working Learning owner for D5-D8 on branch b-learning-upgrade.
precedence.route_context: This batch follows M1-M8 in the fresh route. The old candidate route placed D5-D8 before M5-M8, but D7/D8 explicitly call lipid/ketone/nitrogen substrate and therefore now follow the completed metabolic foundation.
precedence.m9_boundary: D8 frontmatter broadly declares M2-M9 as prerequisites, but its actual learner-facing recall chain explicitly depends on M4/M7/M8 and D7; no M9-specific mechanism is required to understand the current D8 causal spine. learning_arc.question: 机体怎样把底物和能量状态感知成神经/激素输出，在进食、空腹、应激之间切换储存与动员；当胰岛素信号绝对缺乏或抵抗失代偿时，为什么会从高血糖一路发展到DKA/HHS、慢性器官损伤，并最终决定检查与治疗？
causal_spine: D5 first defines system state: energy expenditure, heat balance and stress catabolism determine what the body is trying to do and when nutritional support is needed.
D6 provides the controller language: hormone source/secretion, hypothalamic-pituitary axes, feedback, receptor class and functional localization of excess/deficiency/resistance.
D7 applies that language to the islet: insulin sensing/output and glucagon determine fed-versus-fasted substrate routing over the already learned M1-M8 pathways.

D8 is then a failure model rather than a new list: loss of insulin action explains hyperglycemia, lipolysis/ketogenesis, acute crises, chronic vascular-organ injury, diagnostic tests and treatment targets.
learning_arc.exit_reconstruction: 闭卷从『能量/应激状态是什么』讲到『激素轴怎样感知和反馈』，再画进食vs空腹的胰岛素/胰高血糖素切换，最后用同一模型解释T1/T2、DKA/HHS、慢性并发症、C肽/诊断与治疗靶点。

logic_groups.label: 能量账：ATP、热、底物识别与BMR
